_README: Figures and charts recovered from source PDFs for questions whose visual
content was missing or flattened in the staged text.
Applied by build_bank.py AFTER the answer/figureBased logic, keyed by the
BANK question id (the slug-qNNN form the .ts ships), never by paper+qnum.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. Earlier recoveries were, on 2026-10-02, hand-edited
straight into src/data/banks/mpsc-udc-ldc.ts. That file is generated, and
the edits did not survive the next build_bank.py run: the five imagePath
fields vanished and the four questions silently reverted to figureBased with
the old 'lost in scanning' explanations. Nothing warned -- a rebuild that
loses work looks exactly like a rebuild that has nothing to do. So the
recovery now lives here, in the inputs, like every other correction.
FIELDS (all optional per entry):
imagePath       file under public/question-images/ to show
question        replacement stem, for a printed stem too garbled to read
explanation     replacement explanation; supersedes the solver's text
figureRecovered true when the recovered figure makes the question
ANSWERABLE, so figureBased is cleared and it rejoins
scored tests. Leave it out when the options are still
unreadable images (q081 below), which keeps figureBased.
PROVENANCE. The current attached PNGs are crops of the real source-page
scans. The three unused SVGs in public/question-images/ (reasoning-dice-
positions, reasoning-mirror-mn, reasoning-paper-pieces) remain deliberately
unattached: their source scans are lost and wiring invented reconstructions
to questions would present fabricated figures as real exam items.

mpsc-ldc-2025-paper-2-q061.explanation: The recovered altitude–time graph is horizontal during two level-flight intervals: 10–50 minutes (40 minutes) and 70–100 minutes (30 minutes). Therefore, total level flight is 40 + 30 = 70 minutes, so option C is correct.

mpsc-ldc-2025-paper-2-q062.explanation: The recovered bar chart shows R&D at 5% of total expenditure. Therefore, total expenditure/R&D expenditure = 100/5 = 20, so option B is correct.

mpsc-ldc-2025-paper-2-q075.explanation: From the pie chart, pomegranate is 54° and grapes are 36°. Their combined share is 90°/360° = 1/4 of ₹500, so the difference is (54−36)/360 × ₹500 = ₹25; option A is correct.

mpsc-asst-udc-2024-paper-2-q063.explanation: The pie chart labels walking as 60° and 180 students. Since 60° is one-sixth of the circle, total students = 180 × 6 = 1,080, so option C is correct.

mpsc-asst-udc-2024-paper-2-q064.explanation: The line graph gives 40, 55, 45, 65, 70 and 60. Their sum is 335; 335/6 = 55.833…%, so option B (55.83%) is correct.

mpsc-asst-udc-2024-paper-2-q065.explanation: From the bar graph, the largest year-on-year increase is 53 to 65, from 2015 to 2016 (+12). Therefore, option C, 2016, is correct.

mpsc-udc-combined-2025-paper-2-q055.explanation: Adding the three plotted values for each year gives equal totals in 2022 and 2024 (150 in each case), so option C is correct.

mpsc-udc-combined-2025-paper-2-q056.explanation: For 2021–2024, girls total 60+50+70+80 = 260 and boys total 40+60+50+70 = 220. The ratio of averages is therefore 260:220 = 13:11, option B.

mpsc-udc-combined-2025-paper-2-q057.explanation: Cement accounts for 20% of the building expenditure. Its pie-chart angle is 20% × 360° = 72°, so option D is correct.

mpsc-asst-udc-2025oct-paper-2-q075.explanation: The source scan preserves the printed question combination and all four mirror-image options. Reflecting the combination about the vertical mirror line gives option (3), which is the answer recorded for this item.

mpsc-asst-udc-2025oct-paper-2-q078.explanation: The source scan preserves the question figure, mirror line AB and all four answer figures. A left–right reflection gives option (1).
